title: Fish Tacos
description: A delicious and easy Mexican recipe featuring fish, with a tangy twist.

ingredients.name: Fish
ingredients.notes: white fish such as tilapia or mahi-mahi

instructions: 1. Preheat a non-stick skillet or griddle over medium-high heat.
2. Season the fish with salt and pepper.
3. Add the olive oil to the skillet and sear the fish for 3-4 minutes per side, until cooked through.
4. Warm the tortillas by wrapping them in a damp paper towel and microwaving for 20-30 seconds.
5. Flake the fish into small pieces and place on a warmed tortilla.
6. Drizzle with Malaysian fish sauce and a squeeze of lime juice.
7. Top with a dollop of whipped sour cream and sprinkle with chopped cilantro.
